OR (fp.subject_type = 'role' AND fp.subject_id IN #{rid})

mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM doc_file f WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.folder_id = #{folderId} AND ORDER BY f.file_name

SELECT f.* FROM doc_file f LEFT JOIN doc_file_text t ON t.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( f.file_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR f.description ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR t.extract_text ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) AND ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
